mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBERID, d.USERID, d.PASSWORD, d.NAME, m.ROLE FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID WHERE d.USERID = #{userId} AND d.PASSWORD = #{password} AND m.STATUS = '일반' AND m.DELETEDAT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBERID, ROLE, STATUS, CREATEDAT, DELETEDAT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{role}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, NULL)

INSERT INTO MEMBERDETAIL ( MEMBERID, USERID, PASSWORD, EMAIL, PHONE, BIRTH, NAME, UPDATEDAT, REFUNDACCOUNT, BANKNAME, ACCOUNTHOLDER ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, TO_DATE(#{birth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{name}, SYSDATE,
TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{refundAccount}, '-', ''))
NULL
, #{bankName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountHolder,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO ADDRESS ( ADDRESSID, MEMBERID, RECEIVER, RECEIVERNO, ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIPCODE, ISDEFAULT ) VALUES ( ADDRESS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{name}, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), #{addr1}, #{addr2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zip}, 'yes' )

mapper.select:
SELECT m.MEMBERID, m.ROLE, m.STATUS, TO_CHAR(m.CREATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createAt, TO_CHAR(m.DELETEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deleteAt, d.USERID, d.NAME, d.EMAIL, d.PHONE, TO_CHAR(d.BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, TO_CHAR(d.UPDATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateAt, d.REFUNDACCOUNT, d.BANKNAME, d.ACCOUNTHOLDER, a.ZIPCODE AS zip, a.ADDR1, a.ADDR2 FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID LEFT JOIN ADDRESS a ON a.ADDRESSID = ( SELECT MIN(a2.ADDRESSID) FROM ADDRESS a2 WHERE a2.MEMBERID = m.MEMBERID AND LOWER(a2.ISDEFAULT) = 'yes' )
ORDER BY m.MEMBERID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET ROLE = #{role}, STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL

MERGE INTO ADDRESS a USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBERID FROM dual) src ON (a.MEMBERID = src.MEMBERID AND LOWER(a.ISDEFAULT) = 'yes') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.RECEIVER = #{name}, a.RECEIVERNO = TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), a.ADDR1 = #{addr1}, a.ADDR2 = #{addr2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.ZIPCODE = #{zip} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ADDRESSID, MEMBERID, RECEIVER, RECEIVERNO, ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIPCODE, ISDEFAULT) VALUES ( ADDRESS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{name}, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), #{addr1}, #{addr2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zip}, 'yes' )
UPDATE MEMBER SET DELETEDAT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = '일반', DELETEDAT = NULL WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NOT NULL
